commands.name: mm
commands.description: Massmarket: /mm (what needs you) · /mm link <client> · /mm update <client> · /mm start <client> · /mm view · /mm unlink · /mm status · /mm pause|resume

tools.name: mm
tools.description: Massmarket bridge, the same as the /mm command. args: "" or "queue" (who needs the person now), "status", "view" (this thread's client in the side pane), "link <client>" (make this thread that client's: a name or project id of any client in the feed), "unlink", "pause", "resume". Starting or updating a client thread is for the person only: they press the button in the pane or type /mm start <client> or /mm update <client>. Use it only when the person asks; it never sends anything to a client.
